**Factual-accuracy warnings:**
- `docs/site-src/architecture/bootstrap-fail-fast.md`: `parse_frontmatter_strict` raises a distinct `FrontmatterParseError` on malformed YAML, so the orchestrator surfaces the exact failure instead of masking it as a missing-header case. (vs `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/bootstrap-fail-fast.md`: After `page-author` returns `ok: true`, the orchestrator invokes the callback — by default, it reads the written file and confirms the frontmatter parses cleanly and is non-empty. (vs `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/bootstrap-fail-fast.md`: `_BootstrapProgress` writes an atomic per-page progress file to a `.bootstrap-progress/` directory under the run's working tree. (vs `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/bootstrap-fail-fast.md`: Each record is written after a successful per-page dispatch and checked at startup on re-entry. If the same run hour is re-entered…the orchestrator skips pages that already have a completed progress record rather than re-dispatching them. (vs `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/lint-rules.md`: Hosts that need to disable [description_quality] must set `lint.tier1.description_quality: false` in their config. (vs `scripts/lint/lint_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/lint-rules.md`: Without [--json], the runner prints human-readable findings grouped by file and rule. (vs `scripts/lint/lint_runner.py`)
